name: Abell 1650 (Hubble)
blurb: Abell 1650, a galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: abell1650-hubble
story: A quiet stretch of the galaxy cluster Abell 1650, where a supernova once flared with no galaxy around it. Its star seems to have lived among the cluster's drifting intracluster stars, far from any home galaxy.

claims.text: Abell 1650 is a cluster of galaxies
A1650 is an alternate designation for Abell 1650
This pointing is the location of an apparently hostless Type Ia supernova in Abell 1650, imaged after it faded
The Abell 1650 supernova has no host galaxy
The hostless supernovae's progenitors belong to the intracluster stellar population
